kāsika.cp: adj. belonging to or made of kāsi.
kāsika.p: [Kāsī+ika] (pu) CL=7 (1) Kāsi country. See - Kāsikaraṭṭha. (Ti) (2) A city is named Kāsika. A city is named Kāsi. See also  - Kāsinagara. (3) Arises or being in the Kāsi country.
pn: Kāsika. A city. Sixty-five kappas ago the Thera Bodhighariya lived there as Cakkavatti. The city was built by Vissakamma and was ten leagues in length and eight in width. It was built entirely of precious metals. The king’s palace was called Maṅgala. Ap.ii.401.
Kāsika. The name of a tribe; probably the inhabitants of Kāsi. Ap.ii.359.
